editorial:
You walk into what looks like a normal escape room, but the puzzles quickly turn deadly. Six strangers, each carrying hidden pain, must work together while the rooms shift around them. The vibe is tense and playful at the same time, like a deadly game show where every clue matters. You feel the pressure as time runs out and the walls close in.

The acting keeps you invested, especially as fear cracks each character open. The set design is clever, and the pacing rarely slows down. On the downside, some twists feel a bit silly, and the ending sets up more story than it finishes. Still, if you enjoy puzzle thrillers and group survival stories, this is a fun ride.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the escape rooms are run by a secret group that bets on who survives. Zoey and Ben make it out, but the mastermind is still watching. Zoey refuses to stay quiet and returns to the building to confront them. Ben joins her, and the movie ends with them heading back into danger, setting up a bigger fight ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzle thrillers and survival stories.
